caption: The drawing is a technical blueprint of a chair, presented in black lines on a yellowed, off-white background. It includes four main views: a top elevation, a front elevation, a side elevation, and a detail of the leg cross-section. The top elevation view shows the seat of the chair as a trapezoidal shape with measurements indicating a width of 19 3/8 inches at the back and 19 1/4 inches at the front, and a depth of 16 inches. The front elevation displays the backrest, which is shaped with curves and two symmetrically carved elements, and the legs, which curve outward. The seat is clearly marked as upholstered, noted in the legend at the bottom. The side elevation illustrates the profile of the chair, depicting the curved back support, the thickness and position of the seat, and the shaped legs and stretcher. A zoomed-in cross-section of the legs at point A and a partial cross-section of the stretcher at the front are shown in the upper left corner. The drawing is annotated with dimensions, labels, and a legend that identifies symbols for dowel pins and upholstery. The scale is specified as 1/8 inch equals 1 inch, and the dimensions of the chair are marked in both the elevation and plan views. The drawing uses thin and uniform line work, with instructional notes and measurements written in all capital letters.
title: Chair
